question: Was the first response received within the service standard for this channel?
Was an expected resolution time communicated?
Was the response clear and free of unexplained jargon?
Was the response offered or provided in the customer's preferred language (Arabic / English)?
Was the written response well structured and free of errors?
Did the agent listen without interrupting and confirm understanding?
Was the customer greeted courteously and addressed respectfully?
Did the staff member identify themselves (name or ID)?
Did the staff member keep a neutral, impartial tone (no legal advice given)?
Was the information provided correct against the published procedure?
Was the information complete (documents, fees, timelines)?
Was the customer directed to the correct official page, form or e-service?
Was the enquiry resolved at first contact?
If not resolved, was a clear next step or referral given?
Was the transaction completed correctly (documents accepted, receipt issued)?
Was the environment / channel easy to use (signage, menus, accessibility)?
Did the interaction feel efficient overall?
